name: Montana Tech Materials Science and Engineering Summer Program
what_you_do: Spend a week on the Montana Tech campus. Do hands-on tasks, go on field trips and visit local industry sites. Hear experts talk about metals and materials.
grades: Rising high school juniors and seniors
who_can_apply: Montana high school students who are rising juniors or seniors and want a career in science or engineering. No GPA or age rule is listed.
pay_detail: Free. Lodging, meals and course materials are provided. You must arrange your own ride to campus.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 21 to 26, 2026. The application closed March 31, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application when it opens. Questions: metcamp@mtech.edu.
notes: The dates and deadline come from the 2026 news release on the Montana Tech site. The program page says Montana high school students are invited to apply. Watch for a new release around February 2027.
